article_title: Where do you know what you know? The representation of semantic knowledge in the human brain
supported_points: The reviewed hub account predicts that damage to the proposed amodal hub should impair semantic performance across input modalities, output modalities, and concept types.
The article reports semantic dementia as showing the corresponding cross-modal and cross-concept pattern and treats this as evidence for anterior temporal lobe hub involvement.
interpretive_boundary: This source pin supports the positive mini-case as an illustration of discriminating empirical commitment. It is not treated as a completed cross-source capacity-identity result or as an independent validation of the Paper 2 reconstruction.
